name: simaphore
description: Traffic lights for iOS simulators, Android emulators and their builds (Xcode, Gradle and the android command) when several Claude Code agents share one Mac: a live panel, a build queue and device leases.

buildJobs.title: Build jobs
buildJobs.description: Value inserted as -jobs after xcodebuild when the command has none, and as --max-workers for Gradle.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: A simulator counts as idle after this many minutes under 2% CPU.

maxBuilds.title: Max builds
maxBuilds.description: How many Claude builds may run at once when memory is fine. Under memory pressure it drops to 1.

swapPercent.title: Swap percent
swapPercent.description: Memory counts as tight when swap used is over this percent of swap total.

maxSims.title: Simulator and emulator limit
maxSims.description: At most this many simulators and Android emulators on at once, counted together. A command that needs another one waits for room; the longest-idle device an agent used is shut down.

renameSims.title: Rename held simulators
renameSims.description: iOS only. While an agent holds a simulator, rename it to "🔒 <who> · <name>". The name comes back when it is freed. Emulators are never renamed.

reservedSims.title: Your simulators
reservedSims.description: Names of simulators, or Android AVD names, that are yours, comma separated. Agents never get these.

lowDiskGb.title: Low disk GB
lowDiskGb.description: The panel warns when free disk space is under this many GB.

asciiSymbols.title: ASCII symbols
asciiSymbols.description: Draw > + x * instead of the check, cross and dot symbols.
